In [[algebraic geometry]], the '''Klein cubic threefold''' is the non-singular [[cubic threefold]] in 4-dimensional [[projective space]] given by the equation

:<math>V^2W+W^2X+X^2Y+Y^2Z+Z^2V =0 \, </math>

studied by {{harvtxt|Klein|1879}}.
Its automorphism group is the group PSL<sub>2</sub>(11) of order 660 {{harv|Adler|1978}}. It is [[unirational]] but not a [[rational variety]]. 
{{harvtxt|Gross|Popescu|2001}} showed that it is birational to the [[moduli space]] of (1,11)-polarized [[abelian surface]]s.
